_comment: Auto-analysis trigger rules. Edit this file to change which labels fire which analysis, without touching code. Loaded by src/cddbs/pipeline/article_labeling.py; a redeploy picks up changes. The caps and the kill switch can also be overridden by environment variables (see config.py) so they can be changed from the Render dashboard without a deploy.
_comment_labels: Keyword -> label map for single articles from RSS/GDELT. A label matches if any of its keywords appears in the lowercased article title. This is the backend's copy of what the Intel Feed badge shows; the frontend reads the stored label so the two cannot drift.
_comment_priority: First match wins, so order matters. An article about a 'missile attack during the election' is BREAKING, not INTEL.
_comment_article_triggers: Which article labels fire an analysis run on the article's source outlet. Add labels to `labels` to widen this later, e.g. ["BREAKING", "DISINFO"].
_comment_cluster_triggers: Which event cluster types fire a SitRep + topic run. event_type is assigned by pipeline/event_clustering.py; the available types are conflict, protest, diplomacy, disaster, cyber, info_warfare, economic and other.
